message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features two caricatured figures dressed as magicians. In the foreground, a person wearing a white hijab and a matching white collared uniform with gold buttons and epaulets holds a black top hat over their head. Their facial features are exaggerated with a wide smile and two small moles on their cheek. They hold their other hand open, from which a glowing orb of light emanates. Small white numbers like "0," "1," "2," and "3" float within and around this light. 

To the right, a second figure in a similar white uniform and black top hat stands slightly further back, holding a black and white magic wand directed toward the glowing numbers. The background is a dark reddish-brown. 

Large white and yellow text at the top reads "TEMPO" and "50 Tahun!". Other text includes "PUTUSAN GANJIL DEWAN PENGAWAS KPK," "TRIK BERKELIT LION AIR," and "ABRAKADABRA DATA CORONA." Below this, a paragraph begins with "Sejumlah kepala daerah melaporkan data pasien Covid tak sesuai fakta." In the bottom right corner are a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "26 JULI-1 AGUSTUS 2021."
